dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: How have things been lately? I hope all is well.

choices.text: I'm not as tired as before.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But I hear that you continue to extend your assistance to individuals of all stripes, even at the risk of your own safety.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Or perhaps you have already found the secret to balancing the rigors of battle with the comfort of rest?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If that is the case, it is a secret I must learn from you.

choices.text: How have you been doing lately, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Thank you for asking. All is well with me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Boss was the one who suggested that I come to Nod-Krai to experience the sounds of nature in a different land.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I've also taken the opportunity to visit Heizou's adventurer friend with a few gifts.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: When I learned of this contest, I agreed to take part as I believed this to be an excellent opportunity to broaden my horizons.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: After all, I still have much to learn in the ways of martial arts.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I haven't had any conflicts with the Fatui here, and they seem to maintain some kind of cooperation with you. So I'll treat them with neutrality.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Also, learning about the different combat styles of the Fatui would be nothing but beneficial.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: #I'll be counting on you this time, {NICKNAME}. Guide them so they may demonstrate the very best of their abilities.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes, do whatever you have to do first. There is no rush.
